title: Case manifest
description: cases/<case>/case.json: the names and paths (relative to the case's directory) of what a case provides to the core (docs/case-interface.md). core/tools/case.py reads it; core/tools/stage_project.py stages its mdeo directories; core/tools/check_case.py checks it.

name.description: the case's directory name under cases/

sessionModel.description: the case's session module (imports core/generator/sessions.py; provides LOGIN, pcm, loadprofile, workload_rates; optional request_rates)

parts.description: the timing parts per operation and access (schema/parts.schema.json)

envelopeEstimate.description: the effect steps' envelope estimate, used while parts has no envelope (schema/envelope-estimate.schema.json)

latencyFit.description: the latency-only waits (schema/latency-fit.schema.json); placeholders while missing

cacheHits.description: per-site cache hit ratios and staleness (schema/cache-hits.schema.json)

budgets.description: today's simulated statistics per request type (core/tools/gen_domain_budgets.sh); no budgets while missing

bounds.description: today's objectives the ObjectiveBounds refer to (core/tools/gen_domain_budgets.sh); no bounds while missing

adapter.description: the case's adapter module (core/generator/case-stub/adapter.py lists what it provides)

mdeo.description: the case's MDEO files by role, staged as models/ (models, seeds) and optimize/domain/ (configs)
